title: Tunnel Expired (Trycloudflare Ghost)
style: glitch breakbeat, dub sirens, broken modem squeal, 140 bpm, 336 hz subharmonic, error-tone hook, sysadmin chant
lyrics:
[Intro]
DNS lookup, host unknown
return the favor, dial tone

[Verse 1]
spun a tunnel up at noon
shared the link, sent it soon
laptop slept and the tunnel died
friend on the other end open eyed

[Chorus]
tunnel expired, ghost in the wire
particle pins collectable fire
link looked alive, link was a lie
trycloudflare said goodbye

[Verse 2]
ephemeral host, ephemeral pride
cloudflared process never lied
kill the term and the door slams shut
no page, no app, no nothing but

[Chorus]
tunnel expired, ghost in the wire
particle pins collectable fire
link looked alive, link was a lie
trycloudflare said goodbye

[Outro]
named tunnel next time, pin it down
or pages on a permanent town
